Strategy: Tile the leftovers. Prefer bins whose leftover is an exact multiple of the item size, so the leftover can be filled by later same-size items with no waste. Score bins by leftover with a bonus for exact multiples, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a bin leaving a tileable leftover. Exact fits rank top. It may help by keeping leftovers perfectly reusable, but may fail because later items rarely repeat this size, so the bonus buys nothing.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if (r - item) % item == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Tiling bonus: bonus when post-placement leftover is an exact multiple of item.
